description: An interview becomes what has to go on air: ten timecoded lower-thirds for the TV edit, or a headline-and-copy news item
client_copy: De cada entrevista te deja lo que va al aire: los diez zócalos para la edición, o la noticia lista para publicar.
_comment: THE FIRST CUSTOM PLUGIN OF THE NEW MODEL, and it is here instead of in one
agent's data/ for the reason plugins/README.md gives: lower-thirds for a TV
edit is not one company's shape, it is TV-PRODUCTION's shape, and the second
production company that walks in should get it off the shelf. The client it
was commissioned by is in the catalog row's internal_note, never in here:
nothing in this folder names a client, a channel or a programme.
WHY A PLUGIN AND NOT TWO CLIENT-WRITTEN FLOWS. `create_flow.py` caps a flow
body at 7 steps x 320 characters and the portal shows it to the client. The
craft in `lower-thirds` and `news-copy` -- what counts as a zócalo, what a
headline may not do -- does not fit in that budget and should not be shown
as steps. A skill is the surface for a craft; a flow is the surface for when
it runs. And a flow written into an agent's data/ dies with the agent, which
is exactly what happened to the originals (docs/east-requirements.md).
THE VIDEO SOURCE LIVES IN `lower-thirds`, NOT IN `transcribe`, and this is a
decision the dossier's 4.5 left open. `transcribe` is a `level: base` plugin
-- on EVERY agent, in every prompt -- and its contract is FILE -> TEXT.
Teaching it about URLs would put a video downloader and its prose on every
client who never sends one. Sources are their own unit: `drive-inbox` is a
source, `fetch_video.py` is a source, and both hand `transcribe` a file. The
rule that MUST not move is the other half of 4.5: the transcript comes from
the model connection, never from the platform's automatic captions.
APPROVAL IS ONE GATE PER UNIT OF WORK, not per action. A zócalo is a quote
attributed to somebody on screen and a wrong one is a correction on air, so
the list goes to the client's yes before it is handed to the edit; the news
item goes to their yes before anything is published anywhere. One approval
per interview and one per note, on the ticket that work already has -- what
the `approval` skill asks for, and not the 'ask for everything' that teaches
a client to approve without reading.
AND THAT TICKET IS OPENED BY CODE ON BOTH HALVES, since 30/8/2026. The
interview side had `fetch_video.py` doing it from day one, keyed on the video
id. The news side had a sentence, and a re-run measured what a sentence is
worth: a correct deliverable, and a board that never heard about it -- no
ticket, no approval, no trace (docs/east-requirements.md 5.5). So
`open_news_ticket.py` opens it too, keyed on the normalized source, and the
SKILL.md's step 1 is running it. The words are still the model's; the ticket
is not.
THE SECOND FLOW IS NOT CALLED `radio-viva`, AND THE DOSSIER SAID IT WOULD BE.
Radio Viva is the outlet one client publishes into -- naming a slug after it
would put a third party's brand in every agent that ever buys this row, which
is what PRINCIPLE ZERO forbids. The work is `noticia-para-publicar`; who it
gets published by is the client's business, not the kit's.
